# Arise Infra - Mumbai's Building Material Supplier
Arise Infra is a premier building material supplier in Mumbai, specializing in high-quality aggregates, M-Sand, and river sand. With 15+ years of experience and 500+ projects served, we ensure reliable delivery and industrial-grade quality.

## Core Products
- Aggregates (10mm - 40mm, high-strength for RCC)
- M-Sand (Eco-friendly, strong concrete bonding)
- River Sand (Organic impurity-free, smooth finish)

## Key Benefits
- 99.5% On-Time Delivery Rate
- 24/7 Mumbai Delivery
- IS 383 Compliant Quality Testing
- Logistics expertise across Mumbai, Thane, and Navi Mumbai
